tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind the shell and every page. shadcn: --background.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table headers, dialog footers, input fills, wells (preview frame, workflow canvas).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dialogs, drawers. shadcn: --card, --popover.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, chips, skeleton base, selected settings tab. shadcn: --muted, --secondary.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, ghost buttons and menu items. shadcn: --accent (shadcn's hover token, not the brand accent).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table rows, dividers, tab underline track. shadcn: --border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons), popover edges, dashed empty states. 3:1 against bg in both themes. shadcn: --input.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-subtle, surface and surface-raised. shadcn: --foreground.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, inactive nav, labels. AA on every neutral surface in both themes. shadcn: --muted-foreground.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, IDs, helper text, column headers, line numbers. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes; never for anything the operator must act on.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code editor, log stream, diff viewer and configuration snapshot background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand violet as TEXT or ICON: links, active nav icon, focus ring, selected-tab marker text. AA on bg and surface in both themes. shadcn: --ring.

tokens.name: accent-solid
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, logo tile, selected tab underline, active switch, jump-to-latest pill. Pair with on-accent text (5.7:1). shadcn: --primary.

tokens.name: accent-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent-solid controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-solid. shadcn: --primary-foreground.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected picker card, command-palette highlight, project avatar fill. Text on it stays text or accent.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Opaque violet tint for illustration and cover blocks where an alpha fill would vanish.

tokens.name: run-queued
tokens.usage: Queued run: pill text and dot. On run-queued-soft.

tokens.name: run-queued-soft
tokens.usage: Queued pill fill.

tokens.name: run-running
tokens.usage: Running run, Building preview, current timeline step, info banners. Text on run-running-soft or surface. Its dot pulses.

tokens.name: run-running-soft
tokens.usage: Running pill fill, hunk header rows in diffs, current-step halo.

tokens.name: run-awaiting
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval, approval-gate steps, warnings, rate limit. The only colour that asks the operator to act.

tokens.name: run-awaiting-soft
tokens.usage: Awaiting pill fill, review bar icon tile, approval step card, warning banner.

tokens.name: run-succeeded
tokens.usage: Succeeded / merged / healthy / connected, passing tests, diff additions. On run-succeeded-soft or surface.

tokens.name: run-succeeded-soft
tokens.usage: Succeeded pill fill, done timeline node, success banner, added diff lines.

tokens.name: run-failed
tokens.usage: Failed run, unhealthy preview, failing tests, validation errors, destructive outline buttons, diff deletions.

tokens.name: run-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Failed pill fill, error card, error banner, removed diff lines.

tokens.name: run-cancelled
tokens.usage: Cancelled / rejected / stopped. Outlined pill (border-strong edge, no fill): deliberately quiet.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Confirm button in destructive dialogs only (Cancel run, Stop preview, Archive, Reject). White text, 4.8:1. shadcn: --destructive.

tokens.name: dot-green
tokens.usage: 8px health dot: healthy service, connected, signed-in host. Always next to a text label.

tokens.name: dot-blue
tokens.usage: 8px health dot: building / starting (pulses).

tokens.name: dot-amber
tokens.usage: 8px dot: awaiting approval in the global run indicator.

tokens.name: dot-red
tokens.usage: 8px dot: unhealthy service.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, drawer titles, empty-state headings.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headers, entity names in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Runs always use an immutable published snapshot.
styles.usage: Default UI text and table cells (13.5px is allowed in dense tables).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status pills, chips, badges, column headers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Popover and palette group headers. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Log stream, diff viewer, code editor. 20px rows keep gutters aligned.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Branch names, worktree paths and URLs inside dense rows.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Run IDs, commit SHAs, model names, file names in headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-count gaps, chip internals.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside list rows; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap between cards, dialog field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked page sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page horizontal padding at desktop width.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding; empty-state vertical padding (64px = space-12 + space-4).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, segmented-control thumbs, small menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, popovers' items, log/diff panels. shadcn: --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, empty states, the review bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, filter chips, avatars, dots.

shadow.note: Borders do the structural work; shadows only lift things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Selected segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, toasts, the command palette, the sticky review bar.

size.note: Control heights. Touch targets stay at least 28px with 8px spacing; primary flows use md or lg.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, filter chips, toolbar actions inside cards.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, icon buttons, inputs (38px), top-bar controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Login submit and other single primary actions.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar; collapsed is 64px (icons only).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content inside the main column.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky review bar.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
